等式 $z+e^z=xy^2$ 两端对 $x$ 求偏导，得

$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+e^z\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=y^2
$$

则

$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\frac{y^2}{1+e^z}
$$

同理可得

$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{2xy}{1+e^z}
$$

则

$$
dz=\frac{1}{1+e^z}(y^2dx+2xydy)
$$
